technique_name: Compare and contrast two theories of evolution.
description: The two main theories of evolution are Lamarckism and Darwinism. Lamarckism, proposed by Jean-Baptiste Lamarck in 1809, states that organisms can pass acquired traits to their offspring. This is the idea of “use and disuse”, where organisms modify their behavior and organs to better fit their environment, and these changes then get inherited.
